display_contract.front: Arabic script only; no translation, English question, transliteration, definition, or hint.
display_contract.back: All translations, definitions, examples, grammar/register data, metadata, and eight layered fields.
display_contract.retrieval_direction: Arabic -> meaning/use first; alternate representations are scheduled separately.

source_basis.note: Concepts were learned before the public-source migration; these public/open sources validate and reinforce the same material.

cards.title: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر
cards.definition_en: A greeting used in the morning.

layers.concept_expansion: A time-specific greeting used in the morning.
layers.worked_or_physical_example: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ. كَيْفَ حَالُكُمْ؟ — Good morning. How are you all?
layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: Use a later-day greeting such as مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر when morning has passed.
layers.transfer_prompt: Enter a classroom at 9 a.m. and greet the group appropriately.
layers.mastery_evidence: Recognize and produce the greeting automatically in a morning context.

cards.title: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر
cards.definition_ar: تَحِيَّةٌ تُقالُ في المَساءِ أَو بَعْدَ الصَّباحِ.
cards.definition_en: A greeting used later in the day, especially afternoon/evening.

layers.concept_expansion: The later-day counterpart to صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر.
layers.worked_or_physical_example: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْرِ. كَيْفَ حالُكِ؟ — Good evening. How are you?
layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: It is time-sensitive; مَرْحَبًا remains a neutral greeting at any time.
layers.connections_and_memory: Learn it as a contrast pair with صَبَاحُ الْخَيْر.
layers.transfer_prompt: Choose the correct greeting for a 7 p.m. encounter.
layers.mastery_evidence: Select and produce the correct time-of-day greeting without translating first.

cards.title: كَيْفَ حَالُكُمَا؟
cards.definition_ar: سُؤالٌ عَنِ الحالِ مُوَجَّهٌ إِلى شَخْصَيْنِ.
cards.definition_en: A ‘How are you?’ question addressed to exactly two people.
cards.example_en: How are you two, Ahmad and Maryam?

layers.direct_answer: كَيْفَ حَالُكُمَا؟ = How are you two?
layers.concept_expansion: The suffix ـكُمَا marks a dual second-person addressee: exactly two people.
layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: Dual does not mean ‘a group’; it specifically refers to two.
layers.connections_and_memory: Compare singular ـكَ / ـكِ, dual ـكُمَا, and plural ـكُمْ.
layers.transfer_prompt: Ask two people how they are, then contrast it with the singular form.
layers.mastery_evidence: Choose the dual form automatically whenever there are exactly two addressees.

cards.title: كَيْفَ حَالُكُمْ؟
cards.definition_ar: سُؤالٌ عَنِ الحالِ مُوَجَّهٌ إِلى جَماعَةٍ.
cards.definition_en: A ‘How are you?’ question addressed to a group.

layers.direct_answer: كَيْفَ حَالُكُمْ؟ = How are you all?
layers.concept_expansion: The suffix ـكُمْ marks plural second-person address in this learned form.
layers.worked_or_physical_example: A room of classmates: كَيْفَ حَالُكُمْ؟
layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: Do not substitute the dual ـكُمَا when addressing more than two people.
layers.connections_and_memory: Singular → ـكَ/ـكِ; dual → ـكُمَا; plural → ـكُمْ.
layers.transfer_prompt: Ask one person, two people, and a group how they are using the correct endings.
layers.mastery_evidence: Select the appropriate singular/dual/plural address form from the number of listeners.

cards.title: نَحْنُ بِخَيْر
cards.definition_ar: جُمْلَةٌ تَعْني أَنَّ المُتَكَلِّمِينَ في حالٍ جَيِّدَةٍ.
cards.definition_en: A phrase saying that the speakers are doing well.
cards.example_en: How are you two? — We are fine.

layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: نَحْنُ refers to the speakers, not the people being addressed.
layers.transfer_prompt: Change أَنا بِخَيْر into ‘We are fine.’
layers.mastery_evidence: Recognize and produce نَحْنُ as first-person plural and use the full phrase naturally.

cards.title: كُلُّ شَيْءٍ بِخَيْر
cards.definition_ar: تَعْبيرٌ يَعْني أَنَّ الأُمُورَ جَيِّدَةٌ وَلَا تُوجَدُ مُشْكِلَةٌ.
cards.definition_en: An expression meaning that everything is okay or going well.

layers.direct_answer: كُلُّ شَيْءٍ بِخَيْر = everything is fine.
layers.worked_or_physical_example: لا تَقْلَقْ، كُلُّ شَيْءٍ بِخَيْر. — Don’t worry, everything is fine.
layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: This describes the overall situation rather than specifically saying ‘we are fine.’
layers.connections_and_memory: Reuse the already-known بِخَيْر inside a broader condition statement.
layers.transfer_prompt: Reassure someone that everything is okay using the phrase.
layers.mastery_evidence: Distinguish it from نَحْنُ بِخَيْر and use each in the appropriate context.

cards.title: شُكْرًا
cards.definition_en: An expression used to show thanks or gratitude.

layers.concept_expansion: A very high-frequency expression of gratitude used across registers.
layers.worked_or_physical_example: نَحْنُ بِخَيْر، شُكْرًا. — We are fine, thank you.
layers.boundaries_and_misconceptions: Do not confuse شُكْرًا, which thanks a person/context generally, with الْحَمْدُ لله, which praises and thanks God.
layers.connections_and_memory: Root ش-ك-ر carries the idea of gratitude and thanks.
layers.transfer_prompt: Thank someone naturally after they help you.
layers.mastery_evidence: Recognize شُكْرًا instantly and use it appropriately without translation delay.
